g.text: FLOORPLAN (layer User.1; solid lines: where the RF runs on F.Cu; dotted: the IF, on In2.Cu). Stackup: F.Cu / 0.508 mm RO4003C / In1.Cu ground / prepreg / In2.Cu / FR4 / B.Cu. The printed filters need the solid In1.Cu ground under them and nothing else on F.Cu inside their courtyards.

g.desc: FLOORPLAN (layer User.1; solid lines: where the RF runs on F.Cu; dotted: the IF, on In2.Cu). Stackup: F.Cu / 0.508 mm RO4003C / In1.Cu ground / prepreg / In2.Cu / FR4 / B.Cu. The printed filters need the solid In1.Cu ground under them and nothing else on F.Cu inside their courtyards.

g.text: 50 ohm microstrip on F.Cu is 1.10 mm wide (the filters' port pads). Fence each region with ground vias; LO1 and LO2 keep the project's placement.

g.desc: 50 ohm microstrip on F.Cu is 1.10 mm wide (the filters' port pads). Fence each region with ground vias; LO1 and LO2 keep the project's placement.

g.text: The 12 MHz IF leaves MIX2 on In2.Cu under the high band's feed and comes up at the second IF. IF_DIRECT, REF1/REF2 and the ADC bus also run on In2.Cu.

g.desc: The 12 MHz IF leaves MIX2 on In2.Cu under the high band's feed and comes up at the second IF. IF_DIRECT, REF1/REF2 and the ADC bus also run on In2.Cu.
